description: This file defines the UnsafeMapData class, an implementation of MapData that uses raw memory for storage, including methods for serialization, deserialization, and memory management within the Spark SQL Catalyst module.

classes.name: UnsafeMapData
classes.description: A final class implementing a memory-backed MapData with serialization support, representing a map with unsafe key and value arrays.

methods.name: UnsafeMapData
methods.description: Constructor initializing empty UnsafeArrayData for keys and values.

methods.name: pointTo
methods.description: Sets the internal pointers to point to external memory data, updating baseObject, baseOffset, and sizeInBytes.

methods.name: numElements
methods.description: Returns the number of key-value pairs in the map.

methods.name: keyArray
methods.description: Returns the UnsafeArrayData representing the keys.

methods.name: valueArray
methods.description: Returns the UnsafeArrayData representing the values.

methods.name: writeToMemory
methods.description: Copies the map's data to a specified memory location.

methods.name: writeTo
methods.description: Writes the map's data into a ByteBuffer.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the UnsafeMapData.

methods.name: writeExternal
methods.description: Serializes the map data to an ObjectOutput stream.

methods.name: readExternal
methods.description: Deserializes the map data from an ObjectInput stream.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Serializes the map data using Kryo.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Deserializes the map data using Kryo.
